summary: The RptStaffList module is a web user control used for generating staff list reports within the HSPnet application. It enables users to select departments, validate report generation conditions, and initiate report creation. The control adapts to user roles (DC and Supervisor), and displays appropriate UI elements and validations. JavaScript setup assists with department dropdown integration. Report running is restricted when monitoring another user.
purpose: To allow users to generate a staff list report for a selected department, ensuring appropriate roles and validations are satisfied.

workflows.name: Generate Staff List Report
steps: Departments are retrieved based on user session permissions.
Department dropdown is populated and JavaScript variables initialized.
System validates if at least one staff role (DC or Supervisor) is selected.
If validation fails, error message is displayed.
If validation succeeds, PrintJobs.ReportStaffListCreateJob is called with session and department info.
If monitoring another user (SwitchUserViewOnly), report running button is hidden (Page_PreRender).

business_rules: At least one staff role (DC or Supervisor) must be selected to generate the report.
Report cannot be generated when monitoring another user.

validations.rule: Must select at least one staff role
validations.error_message: At least one Staff Role must be selected

conditions: UserSession.AllowAllDepartments: If true, retrieves all departments; otherwise, restricts to user's agency departments.
ViewState['FirstLoad']: Used to initialize dropdown only on first load.
system_behavior: Populates department dropdown based on permissions.
Sets up JavaScript for department dropdown.
Restricts report generation when monitoring another user.
Displays validation summary and error messages.
exceptions: No staff roles selected prevents report generation.
